content.thinking: My replacement only partially applied (the first `c,_ = rec('e',...)` line and the 'line 8193 syntax' line kept the old values, and a duplicated line 168 remained). Let me fix lines 164-169 directly with sed.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='t3_capture.py'
lines=open(p).read().split('\n')
lines[163] = "c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8178+b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n')])"
lines[165] = "c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8179+b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n')])"
lines[166] = "check('line 8193 syntax', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})"
lines[167] = "check('line 8193 unfinished', rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8178+b' HTTP/1.1\\r')])[0]['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})"
del lines[168]
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(lines))
EOF
sed -n '162,172p' t3_capture.py; cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tmp/t3_capture.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -40
